sides.snippet: Then they understood that he didn't tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
sides.verseText: Then they understood that he didn't tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

sides.snippet: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don't do their works; for they say, and don't do.
sides.verseText: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don't do their works; for they say, and don't do.
